messages:
sara_ops: Quick sync — Q3 hosted capacity plan draft attached. TL;DR: expected token growth +28% vs Q2, seasonal spike in Oct (holiday integrations). Need decision on buy vs short-term lease mix by EOD Fri.

mike_infra: saw the numbers. Do we have SKU mix suggestions? H100s for low-latency chat; A100s or L40 for batching/embeddings?

jess_eng: i ran perf sims overnight. For our 2k rps peak prefix mix, H100s cut 99p latency by ~18% but only ~10% cheaper per token when fully utilized. If we want headroom + lower avg cost, hybrid looks best.

omar_sre: operational note — rolling upgrades to H100 fleet will take ~36 hours per AZ with current canary cadence. Network rebalancing also adds a transient higher p99 (we saw ~120ms bump last time).

lia_finance: budget constraint reminder: we have $2.1M reserved capex for Q3 buys. Leasing consumes opex; need lease terms to be <=6 months or justify multi-quarter commit.

rachel_prod: product requirement: customers on dedicated plan expect <150ms p99 for chat. Hosted API should aim for <120ms p99 after buffer. If we skimp on H100s it's going to impact those routes.

mike_infra: concrete proposal: buy 40 H100s (core latency pool), lease 120 A100/430GB-equivalent for burst and embeddings. Keep 10% spot-enabled for non-critical batch.

jess_eng: addendum: enable prefix KV caching on embeddings-heavy routes — could shave ~12% GPU hours for those flows. That shifts required lease capacity down by ~15 nodes equivalent.

omar_sre: also factor in region constraints — APAC lead times for H100s from vendor partner are ~12-14 weeks; US/EU ~6-8 weeks. If we need APAC headroom by Sept, we must order this week.

lia_finance: ordering timeline noted. If we buy H100s now, depreciation and financing schedule works; if we lease and rates spike we could exceed planned opex. Need vendor quotes before Fri.

sara_ops: action items: 1) Mike to get vendor quotes (buy & 6mo lease) for H100/A100 by Wed. 2) Jess to update perf sims with KV caching on Monday and produce revised GPU-hour delta. 3) Omar to draft upgrade blackout windows and rollback plan. 4) Lia to model P&L impact of three options (buy-heavy, lease-heavy, hybrid) by Thu.

mike_infra: on it. Reaching out to three providers (vendorA, vendorB, coloPartner). also checking rack space and PDUs — current spare racks in us-east are just 18U free.

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] New capacity forecast file uploaded: s3://redwood-capacity/q3/1881234567-forecast.csv

jess_eng: i pushed a quick script for simulated runs: 
```
# run perf sims
python perf/simulate.py --model=h100 --rps=2000 --prefix-cache=on --duration=7200
```
Will run with caching on Monday morning and share numbers.

omar_sre: one more thing — cross-AZ network egress costs could increase by ~7% with additional H100s placed for locality. Lia, can you throw that into the cost model?

lia_finance: noted, will include network egress and increased power draw (~1.2MW for the buy-heavy plan). Might push us to prefer hybrid.

rachel_prod: if hybrid keeps p99 within target and saves ~10% cost, product is ok. But we need a migration playbook for customers on tail-latency sensitive routes.

sara_ops: cool. let's reconvene Thu 10am PT to lock decision. tagging owners: @mike_infra @jess_eng @omar_sre @lia_finance. If vendor lead times force APAC buys this week we'll accelerate.

mike_infra: FYI vendorA quoted 8-10 week lead for H100 in EU, 14w in APAC. vendorB can do 6w EU but higher unit price. Sending quotes shortly.

jess_eng: preliminary sim with KV caching shows ~13% GPU-hour reduction for embeddings pipelines. I'll confirm full numbers tomorrow.

omar_sre: drafting upgrade playbook now — will include staged AZ upgrades, traffic shifting, and automated rollback. ETA Wed EOD.

lia_finance: got it, will have P&L scenarios by Thu morning. If anyone needs model inputs DM me.

rachel_prod: thanks everyone. if we end up leasing more, add a clause for early termination with vendor. learned this the hard way last cycle. :grimacing:

sara_ops: thanks — great progress. I'll circulate meeting invite for Thu 10am PT and attach vendor quotes and the perf csv once available.

mike_infra: uploaded initial quotes to drive: drive.redwood/team/infra/q3-hw-quotes/

deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Reminder: capacity review sync scheduled Thu 2026-07-08 17:00 UTC

sara_ops: closing note — preferred outcome = hybrid buy+lease with APAC buys prioritized if vendor lead times require it. We'll finalize Thu. :white_check_mark:
